title: DNA extraction and sequencing of Ophiothrix
author: Renata Alitto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tz7ep9n
materials: A fragment of the mitochondrial 16S gene was PCR-amplified using the forward primer 16S Sofi F (5′-CAGTACTCTGACTGTGCAA-3′) and the reverse primer 16S Sofi R (5′-GGAAACTATGATCCAACATC-3′). A fragment of the mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase subunit 1 (COI) gene was amplified using the forward primer COIf-L (5′-CCTGCAGGAGGGGGAGAYCC-3′) and the reverse primer COIa-H (5′-TGTATAGGCGTCTGGATAGTC-3′). PCR reactions were performed using PuReTaq Ready-To-Go™ PCR Beads for 25 μl reactions (GE Heathcare), complemented with 0.5 to 1 μl of 25mM MgCl2. Alternatively, PCR reactions were composed of 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8/1 mM KCl buffer, 1.5 mM MgCl2, and 200 μM each dNTP (Invitrogen). In both cases, 0.4 μM of each primer was used and template DNA concentration (ranging from 25.7 to 917.9 ng/μl) was tested. Thermal cycling consisted of a single step at 94°C for 5 minutes, which was followed by 39 cycles (denaturation at 94°C for 45 seconds, annealing at 45.7°C to 51.3°C for 45 seconds, and extension at 72°C for 60 seconds) and a final extension at 72°C for 3 minutes on a thermal cycler (Eppendorf Mastercycler®).

steps.title: Extract DNA from tube feet
steps.instruction: Soak tube‑feet samples from arms or gonads in two successive changes of Tris‑EDTA (TE) buffer, each for 30 min. After soaking, macerate the tissue in 500 µL TE buffer with a pestle. Add 300 µL of 10 % Chelex 100 solution (Bio‑Rad). Incubate the mixture at 55 °C for 60 min, then boil for 8 min. Cool to room temperature, vortex for 20 s, and centrifuge at 14 000 × g for 60 s. Decant the supernatant and store it refrigerated until used as template in PCR.

substeps.instruction: Soak samples in TE buffer (30 min × 2 changes)

steps.title: Purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR amplicons from excess primers and dNTPs using a Promega purification kit, then keep the purified DNA for sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing reactions
steps.instruction: Set up sequencing reactions with the BigDye Terminator kit (Applied Biosystems) using the same primers that were employed in the PCR amplification.
